coordinate_system: Right-handed Blender XYZ, Z-up, 1 source unit = 1 metre. Matrices below map source local to Blender source world, not assumed Unity space.
triangle_export: Disposable export-only triangulation uses exact source loop triangles and exact source positions. Original per-corner normals are carried through Blender custom-normal storage with measured small encoding error, not bit-identical FBX normals. Raw and imported normal tolerances/results are in FBX_STATIC_READBACK.json. Source flat flags retained. No source blend modified; no UV exists or is generated.
normal_import_policy: REQUIRE imported corner normals. Recalculate is explicitly rejected: plate diagnostic up to 17.51 degrees. Exact source corner normals are stored in this contract for comparison.
